name: Area access: walking into the Dark Portal does not teleport and announces the lock once
contract: The Dark Portal's area trigger 4354 (Blasted Lands, map 0) teleports to Hellfire Peninsula (530, -248.149, 921.875, 84.3885). Blasted Lands itself is not locked, so the player can stand in the portal, but the teleport's destination zone is locked by default and OnPlayerCanTeleportTo refuses it before any loading screen. The refusal chat line is throttled to one per 30 seconds per player, so three trigger packets in a row produce exactly one new chat line. Without the feature the player lands on map 530. Requires the default Coa.Access.* values (all locked).

steps.label: Starts in Blasted Lands at the portal
One chat line announces the lock
Stand in the portal, the trigger fires again
DISCRIMINATING: the repeats inside 30 seconds add no chat line
